projects.label: Featured · Client portal
projects.description: Secure client portal for a liquor store management system: dedicated client accounts, a loyalty club, order tracking, and verified M-PESA and card receipts.

projects.title: HomeScape — Property Marketplace
projects.label: Featured · Property marketplace
projects.description: A property marketplace for finding a home: search listings by type, city and price, contact owners, save properties and request viewings.
features: Search by property type, city, price and buy or rent
Seller accounts for managing listings and inquiries
Saved properties, owner inquiries and viewing appointments
Indicative price estimates based on active asking prices
